intro: Trident blends sophisticated aesthetics with practical functionality. Its floating top with rounded edges offers a comfortable workspace, while the executive desk and credenza provide organisation.

features.title: Designed for senior professionals
features.text: With a spacious main desk, a drawer, and a cabinet, Trident Junior keeps active and extended workspaces neatly segregated.

features.title: Refined European finish
features.text: The elegant European Ash finish, along with duck nose and half-round profiled edges, enhances your office’s aesthetics.

features.title: Durable, stain-resistant work surface
features.text: A laminate finish top ensures resistance to scratches and stains, making your desk as efficient as you are.

features.title: Smart storage solutions
features.text: A small drawer, and a spacious cabinet provide ample storage to keep essentials within easy reach.

features.title: Tidy & organised workspace
features.text: An integrated wire management system keeps cables neatly tucked away for a clutter-free and professional desk setup.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Trident Junior 2 Executive Desk 1500 W
